title: Full Stack Developer - Recent Grad (Health Tech Startup)   🚀
description:
❤️ Want to make a tangible difference in the future of healthcare?

❤️ Love applying the latest technologies to solve tough problems?

❤️ Looking for a fulfilling career with plenty of learning and growth?

About 1Phi 🤩

1Phi is building a first of its kind AI-powered healthcare navigator, called 1Sage, that lets patients find the treatment options with the best clinical outcomes for their unique situation. It continuously monitors and trains on billions of medical records across over 100 million patients nationwide and over 1 million doctors and medical facilities. Patients simply chat with 1Sage, indicating their circumstances and needs. The more information they provide, the better the insights.

1Phi stands for 1st Principles Healthcare Institute, a name that reflects our commitment to R&D and taking an unorthodox approach to solving intractable and persistent industry challenges. As a Public Benefit Corporation, we’re grounded in decades of experience with payer financial models, government policy, provider incentives, and patient empowerment. By deploying artificial intelligence across data assets previously available only to industry insiders, 1Phi is uniquely positioned to bring patients the knowledge to make decisions in their own best interest.

You would be joining an early stage startup team of engineers, healthcare experts and dreamers. You’ll help define the culture, the tech stack, and the future of our industry. Tight-knit team. Zero bureaucracy. Project ownership. Room to experiment. Accelerated growth.

Requirements 🤓

What You’ll Do
• Build our first production-ready full stack application, evolving our prototype (built on an LLM chat bot design pattern) into a scalable, secure platform.
• Own the full stack: front-end user interface, back-end APIs, and integrations across data and AI components. Build interactive inline UI widgets, including tables, forms and maps.
• Collaborate with the data engineer (pipelines, claims data) and AI engineer (model training, inference, streaming LLM responses) to connect the pieces into a seamless patient experience.
• Design and implement secure workflows for patients to input health history and receive treatment options and provider recommendations.
• Establish coding standards, testing practices, CI/CD, and technical architecture for the team to grow on.

You're a fit if:
• BS or MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science or other STEM field.
• At least one significant successful project in production (outside of classroom) that you can demonstrate.
• Experience with full stack development with modern frameworks (React/Vue + Node.js/Python, or similar).
• Experience with APIs, authentication/authorization, and integrating third-party services.
• Comfortable working with databases (SQL/NoSQL).
• Thrive in early-stage chaos and high-impact roles, rather than climbing the corporate ladder or incremental changes.

Even better if:
• Experience with rapid deployment tools (Vercel, Netlify, etc.) for quick feature testing.
• Experience with cloud vendors: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
• Hands on with AI/LLM tools, such as Cursor.AI and Claude Code.
• Familiarity with WebSockets, streaming APIs, realtime voice/WebRTC
• DevOps / infra-as-code familiarity.

Salary: $55k-$95k depending on experience and skills

Location: Chicago office 🏢 (Not remote)

Hiring Process 😎

At 1Phi, we believe hiring should be fair, transparent, and collaborative. We work hard to find the best mix of respecting the candidates time, while also giving our team an efficient way to learn if a candidate is a good fit. Since we also strive to simulate the work environment throughout the process, we encourage you to use all the AI/LLM tools and outside resources at your disposal. During the process, if you ever feel that you are being asked for an onerous amount of work, please do not proceed. The best candidates are those who enjoy the process, regardless of the outcome.

Here’s the entire process: Apply with email → Project demo call (15 mins) → Skills challenge (1-3 hrs) → Interviews (2 hours) → Meet the Team Day and micro-project (1 day) → Offer → Trial period (1-3 weeks)

Benefits 🤑
• Health insurance
• Generous vacation policy + company holidays
• 401K + profit share contributions
• Quarterly evals and performance bonus (~10% at start, ~20% after 4 years)

How to Apply 😇

Send us your resume and any relevant links (LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio site, etc.) to careers+linkedin@1phi.com with the subject: “Recent Grad Full Stack Developer”. Include a description of your most successful project, pointing out how it demonstrates your abilities and resourcefulness in terms of this job description. Indicate whether you need visa sponsorship. (We can sponsor existing H1B holders. OPT candidates must have 2.5+ years remaining on visa.)
